Looking for something different? This personalised doughnut word art print features a pink iced doughnut, built entirely from words. It's a fun birthday or Christmas gift for a friend.

Your personalised doughnut word art print, made with your words

Fill in two boxes: the name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as hobbies, nicknames, friends and favourite things. We repeat the words randomly in different sizes, fonts and shades across the shape, and the preview shows what you've typed next to the print photo.

Single words work best, and no phrase should be longer than three words. Check the spelling carefully, as we print exactly what you enter. Icons, emoji and accents can't be included.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand
  • One of a kind: every word comes from you, so no two prints are the same
  • The name stands out once, and your other words repeat in different sizes, fonts and shades

Size & details

  • Design: a pink iced doughnut, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised doughnut word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.
